blocks.text: ABU DHABI, United Arab Emirates — Washington called for a “new” security framework on the first day of US-led talks between Ukraine and Russia in Abu Dhabi, as Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said he was “happy” with the changes in approach by US mediators. US President Donald Trump’s envoys — his son-in-law Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff — brought the warring sides together for several hours of negotiations, which are set to continue Wednesday. Kushner told delegates that the United States had “narrowed the gaps” between the sides — without providing details — and hoped to move toward a “solution” to […]...
